display_name: The whole Carriage by Air Act 1988 and the three texts of the Warsaw Convention in its Schedules (1929, Hague, Montreal No. 4), each its own answer, as fact-record rules with the limits in the Convention's own units
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 30 Sep 2026: ss 1 to 13 and all three Schedules, every Article and the Additional Protocol of each of the Warsaw Convention (Second Schedule), the Warsaw (Hague) Convention (First Schedule) and the Warsaw (Hague) (Montreal) Convention (Third Schedule). The three texts are three versions and the Convention is an input to every rule where they differ; a text that has no provision on a point answers REFUSE. Inert (no condition or answer of their own): s 1, the five definitions of the Convention and Protocols in s 2, s 6(5), Articles 15(1), 30A, 36, 37(1) and (3), 38(1) and (2), 39(1), 40, 40A(2), 41 and the Article 22 definitions of the franc and the Special Drawing Right; NOTES.md section 2 gives each reason. NOT encoded: the conversion of francs and Special Drawing Rights into Singapore dollars (s 6(4): no Minister's order is an input, so a named REFUSE), the regulations under s 12 (a named REFUSE), the other Acts the Act points at, and the authentic French text that s 3(2) makes prevail. Law stated as at 2026-09-30 (the PDF banner).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the statute or the Convention. An independent test pass was run on 2026-09-30 (tests-independent.l4, 343 assertions, no disagreement), but its author read the modules for names and signatures, and it is not a substitute for expert review. The pipeline has not been run. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation and was not compared with the treaty texts or the authentic French text. NOTES.md section 6.

forks.F1: s 4(1)(e): the Act does not apply to State-performed carriage where the party has availed itself of the Additional Protocol.
forks.F2: Article 20(2) (Second): negligent pilotage reaches destruction, loss or damage of baggage or cargo, not delay.
forks.F3: Article 22(2) (Second): no rule for the weight where part is lost; refuses when other packages are affected.
forks.F4: Article 26(2): 'forthwith' is a condition of the time limit.
forks.F5: Article 13(3): seven days expire on the seventh day, so the right arises from the eighth.
forks.F6: Article 29(2), s 8: two years counted by the anniversary date.
forks.F7: Article 25A(3) (First): the servant loses the limits where his act was intentional or reckless.
forks.F8: Article 34: the documentary provisions do not apply to extraordinary carriage in either the First or the Third Schedule.
forks.F9: s 10(2): does not exclude the Warsaw Convention.
forks.F10: Article 3(2) (Second): forfeiture only for the absence of a ticket.
forks.F11: Article 9 (Second): forfeiture only for the lack of particulars (a) to (i) and (q).
forks.F12: Article 4(4) (Second): no forfeiture for small personal objects the passenger keeps.
forks.F13: Article 21(2) (Third): mandatory exoneration for cargo is a separate rule.
forks.F14: Article 22(2) (Third): the bracketed '[(c)]' weight paragraph applies to baggage and cargo.
forks.F15: Article 1(2): 'another Power' (Second) and 'another State' (First and Third) give one test.
